description: This Java source file defines a custom assertion class for testing SearchResult objects, providing methods to verify pagination properties and to convert JsonValue objects into assertions.

classes.name: SearchResultAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class extending AssertJ's AbstractIterableAssert to verify properties of SearchResult objects in tests.

methods.name: SearchResultAssert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the assertion object with the actual SearchResult instance.

methods.name: hasNextPageOffset
methods.description: Verifies that the SearchResult has the expected next page offset.

methods.name: hasNoNextPage
methods.description: Verifies that the SearchResult does not have a next page.

methods.name: toAssert
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue to a JsonValueAssert for further assertions.

methods.name: newAbstractIterableAssert
methods.description: Creates a new SearchResultAssert from an iterable of JsonValues.
